SETROPTS LIST

THE SETROPTS COMMAND OPTIONS IN EFFECT ARE:

        ATTRIBUTES:
   WHEN(PROGRAM) IS IN EFFECT
   SAUDIT IS IN EFFECT
   OPERAUDIT IS IN EFFECT
   PROTECTALL IS IN EFFECT

     DATASET  FACILITY  PROGRAM  STARTED  CONSOLE  APPL
   GENERIC COMMAND PROCESSING IS IN EFFECT
   STATISTICS ARE BEING MAINTAINED
   INACTIVE USERIDS ARE BEING AUTOMATICALLY REVOKED AFTER 90 DAYS
   SECURITY RETENTION PERIOD IS 0

        PASSWORD PROCESSING OPTIONS:
   THE ACTIVE PASSWORD ENCRYPTION ALGORITHM IS KDFAES
   PASSWORD CHANGE INTERVAL IS 90
   MINIMUM PASSWORD CHANGE INTERVAL IS 0 DAYS
   MIXED CASE PASSWORD SUPPORT IS IN EFFECT
   SPECIAL CHARACTERS IN PASSWORDS ARE NOT IN EFFECT
   PASSWORD MINIMUM LENGTH IS 8
   PASSWORD MAXIMUM LENGTH IS 100
   NO INSTALLATION PASSWORD EXITS HAVE BEEN DEFINED
   PASSWORD HISTORY GENERATIONS IS 10
   NO PASSWORD DATE PATTERNS ARE IN EFFECT
   PASSWORD REVOKE COUNT IS 3

        AUDIT OPTIONS:
   AUDIT PROCESSING IS IN EFFECT
   LOGOPTIONS SUCCESSES(LOGON) ARE BEING LOGGED
   LOGOPTIONS FAILURES(LOGON) ARE BEING LOGGED
   LOGOPTIONS SUCCESSES(RVARY) ARE BEING LOGGED
   LOGOPTIONS FAILURES(RVARY) ARE BEING LOGGED
   LOGOPTIONS FAILURES(ADDSD ALTDSD DELDSD) ARE BEING LOGGED
   SAUDIT IS IN EFFECT
